title: Cloud hosting & environments
objective: Deploy ACMP to AWS as two internet-facing environments — staging/UAT (uat.acmp.anas7ammo.dev) and production (acmp.anas7ammo.dev) — on EC2 + Docker Compose (single host per environment), reducing footprint by folding Keycloak's datastore onto the existing SQL Server, replacing self-hosted MinIO with managed Amazon S3, and consolidating the container set. Includes a manual user-seeding script, a CD image-publish pipeline, backup/restore/DR for two SQL databases, TLS via Let's Encrypt DNS-01, deployment smoke + Playwright testing, and hard AWS spend controls. Post-P19 work: the on-prem P1–P19 ladder is complete; this phase adds a cloud target. RATIFIED 2026-07-24 (ADR-0034..0037 Approved).
exit_criteria: Both environments reachable over HTTPS on their subdomains with a green smoke run and the existing Playwright suite passing against UAT; Keycloak persists to SQL Server with no Postgres container; recordings on S3 with no MinIO container; backup→restore 3→0→3 verified on both databases on Express edition; UAT/prod credential, bucket and DNS isolation proven; budget alerts + auto-stop action provisioned.

title: Activated deferred work
objective: Hold the slices that build the deferred-work rows activated by DEC-067 on 2026-08-20. Created for the same structural reason PH-6 and PH-4 were: slices.phase_id is NOT NULL and every existing phase is either Implemented or deliberately frozen, so activated work has nowhere to live without a new one. PH-3 is deliberately NOT reused - it stays Approved on purpose because WBS-20.4 is the email adapter standing against a hard constraint, and hanging new work off it would blur that. PH-6 is Implemented and closed; reopening a closed phase to hold new work would make its exit meaningless. WHAT THIS PHASE IS NOT: it is not a commitment to build all thirteen activated rows. It holds the slices that are actually scheduled, and rows stay Activated-without-a-slice until somebody schedules them.
exit_criteria: Every slice under PH-7 is Implemented, with each of its work items carrying a real slice_id (the DEC-068 d2 fix-forward rule) and each acceptance criterion recorded with evidence in the session that produced it. The phase does NOT exit merely because the thirteen activated rows are exhausted - rows scheduled into later slices extend it.
